rules.title: San Francisco annual allowable rent increase for 3/1/2026 - 2/28/2027 (1.6%)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable rent increase effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6% of the tenant's base rent (calculated by multiplying base rent by .016).
rules.citation: SF Rent Board announcement, "Annual Rent Increase for 3/1/26 - 2/28/27 Announced", SF.gov, January 14, 2026
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.interaction: Applies for the 3/1/2026-2/28/2027 period; the prior period (3/1/2025-2/28/2026) was 1.4% and has ended. The chunk does not state which units are rent-controlled or any state-law interaction.

warnings: The source is a news announcement and cites no ordinance or code section. The citation field uses the announcement title and date only, so the underlying legal authority needs verification.
The chunk does not define which units are rent-controlled or list exemptions. Coverage relies on the city_rent_controlled fact, and exemptions are null and need review.
The date of enactment or formal adoption of the 1.6% figure is not stated. January 14, 2026 is the posting date of the announcement and was not used as the enacted date.
The prior-year 1.4% increase (3/1/2025-2/28/2026) is mentioned but expired before 2026-10-01 and the schema has no expired status, so no rule was drafted for it.
The 1.6% rate ends February 28, 2027. The next annual rate is not in this source.
The retrieval date (2026-10-01) was not used as an effective date.
Draft only: an administrator must review legal meaning, exemptions, dates and interactions before import.
